Godot 4.7.2 is the current stable 4.7 patch
Blender 5.2.1 LTS is the current LTS with 4.5.13 as a supported fallback
Free local pipeline release pins are Material Maker 1.7, AutoRemesher 1.2.0, bridge v0.1.3, MeshLab 2025.07, and Effekseer 1.80.7
Tripo Studio Free and Pro have different credit, privacy, export, and commercial-use boundaries
Tripo Studio free-credit figures differ between current vendor pages
Tripo API uses pay-as-you-go credits at $0.01 per credit
Rodin Free and Creator have different export and use-rights boundaries
Meshy Free lists 100 monthly credits with CC BY 4.0 attribution and Pro lists 1000 credits with private/full-commercial treatment
Rokoko Starter is free and Basic adds paid AI/retargeting capacity
Cascadeur Free is noncommercial/CASC-only while Indie and Pro add export and commercial rights
Terrain3D v1.0.2 documents Godot 4.4-4.6+ support
ProtonScatter 4.0 release notes describe Godot 4.0-4.2 compatibility
Hunyuan3D-2.1 is an open PBR model-generation pipeline with CUDA-oriented requirements and no documented rigging/animation pipeline
Hunyuan3D-2.1 Community License has territory, service-size, downstream-notice, acceptable-use, and AI/ML restrictions
Kenney individual assets are CC0, free, and commercially usable without attribution while the All-in-1 bundle is optional paid convenience
Mixamo is free with an Adobe ID, supports royalty-free commercial game use, and is biped-focused
Mixamo Additional Terms prohibit using its service, content, data, or output to train or improve AI/ML systems
Tripo Animation Retarget applies presets to rigged models and includes a smaller nonhumanoid preset set than biped coverage
Tripo current rig documentation lists nonhumanoid body types including quadruped, hexapod, octopod, avian, serpentine, and aquatic
Tripo Animation Retarget costs 10 credits per animation and Auto Rig costs 25 credits
